notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet T6-SA1 (vehicle-mounted linemarking sign with temporary hazard marker, L and R): black board (20 black all round and between the parts); yellow legend panel 960 x 240 with LINEMARKING 120 C above a band of black-and-yellow chevrons 300 deep (traced as the yellow layer). The sheet draws one hand; the other mirrors the chevron band only (legend unchanged). Layout: 1000 x 600, black, R0, no border. Legend placed from the sheet's own filled artwork measured at 1200 dpi (letter heights from the ink, series confirmed by the FHWA widths, each word centred on its ink; the sheet's dimension chains were not transcribed one by one for this sign — the positions are the sheet's drawn artwork itself, which the overlay check confirms): symbol yellow fields between the black chevrons (chevron band 340 deep, modules 180 / 160 / 160 / 160 / 160 / 180) x 21-979 y 280-580; LINEMARKING 120 C top 80 x 68-931 (862).
